.qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-08-v16-full/rules/harbor-webdev-rubric-qc/SKILL.md (Known false positives: one criterion covering a whole flow, checks 26/28/33)
qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md (Coverage has two directions; independent credit; negatives need controls)
task/environment/instructions/overview.md, behaviour.md, ui.md, security.md, policy.md, integration.md (all lines)
task/tests/test.sh:98-193 (DB_PATH copy launch, health probes, restart helper)
task/solution/app/src/runtime.ts:33-63,317-366 and app.tsx:48 (golden instruments only the run copy; editor text untouched)
evidence: I built a map from each requirement to its criteria across instruction.md and all six notes (53 criteria: render 1, constraints 2, functional 43, polish 6, visual 3). Every substantive asked-for behavior maps to at least one criterion. EDITOR (ui.md:3-17): own surface -> constraints cw_custom_document_surface; line numbers, 1-based readout, Home/End/arrows and goal column -> cw_caret_navigation_and_line_numbers; typing, new lines, Backspace and Delete -> cw_custom_typing_and_line_join; Ctrl+Home/End and scroll-into-view -> cw_caret_kept_in_view; graphemes and Shift+Arrow -> cw_grapheme_navigation_and_deletion; click, double, triple and drag plus copy -> cw_mouse_selection; replace-on-type/paste and one-step paste undo -> cw_selection_replace_and_paste_undo; unwrapped long line with sideways edit -> cw_long_line_editing; Tab/Shift+Tab including a single-line selection and leaving the next line alone -> cw_block_indent_undo; Alt+Click AND Ctrl/Cmd+Click, a slow burst as one Undo, and Redo -> cw_multi_caret_typing_atomic; multi-caret Backspace/Delete -> cw_multi_caret_delete; same-line carets pushed along -> cw_same_line_carets; caret restored by Undo -> cw_undo_restores_caret; Undo/Redo greyed out after New and after opening a snippet -> polish cw_undo_redo_availability; Undo/Redo shortcuts (Ctrl+Z, Ctrl+Y/Ctrl+Shift+Z) and buttons (visible controls in cw_replace_all_atomic); literal, case-sensitive Find with wrap -> cw_find_forward_backward_wrap; Replace current advances -> cw_replace_current; Replace all as one step with Redo cleared -> cw_replace_all_atomic; replacement containing the search text -> cw_replace_self_containing_text; JS/HTML colouring -> cw_js_semantic_coloring and cw_html_semantic_coloring; Format JS/HTML with two-space nesting, preserved strings/comments, idempotence and one Undo/Redo -> cw_js_format_semantics_and_undo and cw_html_format_semantics_and_undo (the second Format comes before the Undo, so a no-op Undo step from reformatting is also caught); format syntax error keeps the draft -> cw_format_error_keeps_draft; labels and feedback after Run/Save/Format -> cw_controls_feedback_and_labels; keyboard reach, visible focus and the shown escape shortcut -> cw_controls_keyboard_and_focus; focus back to the code after Format/Undo/Redo/replacement/Save -> cw_focus_returns_to_code; unsaved marker, including Undo back to the saved text -> cw_unsaved_marker; 390 px -> cw_narrow_width_usable. RUNTIME (behaviour.md:3-7): isolated fresh .js run with no leakage -> cw_basic_run_output and cw_run_starts_fresh_document; HTML preview with inline script and onclick -> cw_html_preview; syntax error reported with the draft kept, plus thrown-error message and 1-based line including the whole-file HTML line -> cw_error_message_and_line; message and line of an unhandled rejection -> cw_promise_rejection_message_and_line; console order -> cw_console_levels_in_order; output kept after throw/timeout/stop -> cw_output_before_failure_kept; last-good picture with the typed field and canvas after throw/stop/timeout -> cw_last_good_recovery; 5 s budget covering timers, then Run again -> cw_time_limit_recovery; fresh budget for each interaction -> cw_interaction_starts_fresh_budget; Stop cancels timers, intervals and Promise callbacks -> cw_stop_cancels_pending_work; a newer Run supersedes the older one -> cw_newer_run_supersedes. SAVING AND HISTORY (behaviour.md:9-13): exact fields, fresh-page read, persistence across restart and code saved as plain text -> constraints cw_shared_saved_record and cw_save_reload_restart; stale save refused with a message -> cw_stale_save_refused; draft kept -> cw_stale_save_keeps_draft; live library -> cw_live_library_update; refresh keeps draft, caret, scroll, Undo and fields -> cw_live_update_keeps_editing_state; newer-revision notice -> cw_newer_revision_notice_keeps_draft; read-only history, restore as a new revision, and an old page cannot overwrite a newer save -> cw_history_restore_adds_revision; visible HTTP restore and idempotent replay -> cw_restore_request_repeat_safe (plus the replay leg in cw_save_reload_restart). SECURITY (security.md:3-5): parent DOM/title, storage, library, and fetches to localhost and 127.0.0.1 -> cw_preview_isolation; eval/Function/WebAssembly/Worker/dynamic import refused with a reason, while strings and comments are not tripped -> cw_dynamic_code_refused. OVERVIEW: editor, preview and console together -> render gate and cw_visual_workspace_layout; filename chooses the mode -> the .js and .html criteria. INTEGRATION items (port 3000, /api/health, DB_PATH, SQLite, no symlinks) are not product promises a browser can decide. test.sh:98-193 launches the app from a copy with DB_PATH and probes /api/health, and cw_preview_isolation uses health as a control, so the harness exercises them, which REVIEW_POLICY.md accepts (a browser cannot prove SQLite). I found no mandatory behavior that goes ungraded. The items below are legs that are under-graded or only incidentally covered; I record them as P3 notes, not as gaps that let a broken app escape. (1) behaviour.md:3 says 'the editor keeps exactly the code that I ran', but no criterion reads the editor source back after a successful Run. Coverage is incidental: cw_js_format_semantics_and_undo requires one Undo back to the exact original one-line source after Run+Format+Run, which catches a rewrite that is not undoable or not idempotent; cw_error_message_and_line covers it only for the syntax-error draft. The golden leaves the editor text untouched and instruments only the run copy (runtime.ts:33-63, app.tsx:48). (2) ui.md:15 asks to be told why formatting failed, but the criterion only requires 'a visible message must say that formatting failed' (functional judge.toml:209), so a 'Format failed' with no reason passes. (3) ui.md:5 Ctrl+A select-all is graded only as a required step inside cw_newer_run_supersedes (if it fails, the old timer runs and its marker appears, so the criterion fails), not as its own leg. (4) ui.md:17 focus return after 'a replacement' is tested with Replace all only, not Replace current. (5) behaviour.md:5 says the budget covers pending Promise callbacks, but only timer and synchronous loops are tested; to an observer an endless microtask chain behaves like a synchronous loop. Each of these is graded at least in part, and the skill and the workbook annotation say that bundling a flow into one criterion is not a gap.
counterexample: Broken app that could plausibly pass: one that rewrites the editor contents on every Run with an undoable auto-format step. It would still satisfy cw_js_format_semantics_and_undo (Undo returns to the original one-line source), and no other criterion reads the source back after a valid Run, so behaviour.md:3 'the editor keeps exactly the code that I ran' is not directly enforced (although such a rewrite could arguably count as 'the code I ran'). Conforming alternative that could fail: none found. The criteria allow free wording and any layout or selectors, accept either modifier for multi-caret wherever only one is required, accept quote-style changes from Format, and give 10 s windows for the 5 s promises.
suggested_fix: Optional P3 tightening: add a leg to cw_basic_run_output requiring the editor source to read exactly as typed after each Run, and require the cw_format_error_keeps_draft failure message to give a reason (for example, a syntax error). Coverage holds without either change.
